text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hey. Hey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the darkness, a familiar voice can be 
heard. Opening my eyes little by little, 
my vision gradually clears while enveloped 
in brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Oi, you finally woke up, huh? While 
waitin' for you, I became a master at 
peeling off stuck tape without leavin' a 
trace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Right in front of me is Gold Ship in a 
swimsuit. And this place... seems to be a 
peaceful rural field. With a hazy mind, I 
desperately try to trace back my memories—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Cursor scroooll☆ Watermelon 
Slaaaassh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"How about it, how about it?! Behold 
Golshi-chan's Summer-Time Memory Form! You 
could write a hundred-page essay on how 
deeply moving it is, am I right, hey?!"
choice_data_list: Umm... I think it's really great!
Umm... I think it's really great!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Stop spouting nonsense as dull as 
vacuum-packed, dried-out tea leaves! Jeez, 
what am I gonna do with you...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Look over there, there's a worker 
ant carrying delivery soba!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And then, everything was shrouded in 
darkness, and before I knew it, I was 
here."
choice_data_list:
(I remembered, but I still don't get it at 
all!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Well, I drilled most of the operation 
into ya through sleep-learning. You know 
what you gotta do, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it down! The phantom giant 
squid haunting these grounds, which once 
ruled the ancient seas!
choice_data_list: W-Why?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, is your AI from the last 
century!? You truly don't get a damn 
thing, do you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Behold! Feast your eyes on the majestic 
sight of Sir Seaweed, Lord Scallop, Master 
Crab, Sir Starfish, and Princess Pearl 
clinging to Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Renowned sages of the sea are lending 
their power to my racing outfit! Pretty 
amazing, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
They're still whispering to me even now. 
Sea Power alone can't save the world. You 
gotta charge up your Land Power and raid 
the squids' stronghold... they say.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Then, we focus light from the sun into a 
beam and blast the squid—that's Lord 
Wakame and crew's 'Operation: Sun-Dried 
Squid'! Ain't it excitin'?"
choice_data_list: ...H-Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, what'll it be?! Ya wanna go home?! 
Or do ya wanna become heroes with 
Golshi-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don'tcha wanna have your heroic figure 
alongside swimsuit Golshi-chan etched into 
a stone monument, or sold as keychains in 
souvenir shops nationwide!? Don't ya?!
choice_data_list: ...I-I want to! I want to be engraved!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? Look who finally managed to say it, 
you little rascal! Sheesh, you should've 
just been honest from the start, you 
rebellious brat!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then pick up that Plankton Blade over 
there. Careful and slow, though... We're 
already right in the heart of the giant 
squid's nest.
choice_data_list: There are squids already?!
There are squids already?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't sense anything at all, but 
apparently "it's there." Picking up the 
Plankton Blade (wooden stick), I await 
Gold Ship's signal...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah!! Time for an exorcism!! Holy 
Water RUUUUSH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gold Ship went wild, blasting her water 
gun all over the place. Without 
understanding what was happening at all, I 
joined in by swinging a wooden stick, but 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clouds suddenly covered the sun, and the 
ground began to shake. In the distance, 
birds took flight all at once, and a herd 
of deer fled. What on earth could this 
be—!?
choice_data_list: W-What the heck is going on!?
W-What's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"That bastard's finally gotten serious. 
Here comes his ultimate move...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, this is bad... If I don't charge 
Lady Pearl with the power of the sun, I 
won't be able to fire the finishing 
Sunglasses Beam!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Anything works, just give me light! Give 
Golshi-chan... LIGHTTTT!!!!"
choice_data_list: What about using the light on your phone!?
How about the light on your phone!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, well done! Direct that light onto 
Lady Pearl! Uwooooh, let's gooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, the tranquil scenery 
had returned. Does this mean the squid was 
successfully defeated?
choice_data_list: So that was Lady Pearl's power...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Burned into your retinas, wasn't it! 
After all, it's the virtuous pearl oyster 
who wandered the lands to save all living 
souls and became a living Buddha!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't use the sunlight, but we pulled 
through! That was all thanks to you!
choice_data_list:
It's because Lord Wakame and the others 
had a great strategy.

It's because Lord Wakame and the others 
had a great strategy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look who gets it, hey! Feel free to 
worship me, y'know? Go on, go on!
choice_data_list: Bless you, bless you...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! Golshi-chan's racing outfit is the 
All-Stars of the Seven Seas, babyyyy!!
choice_data_list:
To think penlights alone could have so 
much power...

Your racing outfit has definitely leveled 
up too.

Your racing outfit has definitely leveled 
up too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! Golshi-chan's racing outfit is the 
All-Stars of the Seven Seas, babyyyy!!
choice_data_list:
To think penlights alone could have so 
much power...

Your racing outfit has definitely leveled 
up too.

Your racing outfit has definitely leveled 
up too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, real sunlight's way crazier! 'Cause 
it turns into a homecoming beam that 
reaches the sun itself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you don't even have to say it! I bet 
you ended up wanting the same outfit too, 
didn't ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"All right, a special blowout deal from 
Golshi-chan! I'll place an order with the 
sea using my mug as collateral! Just you 
wait and look forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the future where I go to the 
racetrack wearing matching outfits with 
Gold Ship was decided... ...or perhaps, 
doomed to happen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! With this, it's an amphibious, 
super-combined racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, we beat the giant squid, but... 
Now that we've conquered sea and land... 
it won't feel right until we charge up one 
more!
choice_data_list: ...The sky?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong, you got it totally right! Well, 
I'll put a plan together soon enough! Look 
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Waking up to find myself midair. Such a 
scenario crossed my mind, but carried by 
the momentum of the moment, I found myself 
nodding in agreement.
